author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0034356 NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway' 
see  https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29050#issuecomment-2688144539



Annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w2Wa5HsRYopjk5tL_9C5WXb-vu7j9BLLC3DEdod8o5o/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
Reactome : 11
SGD: 7

Note that this term will be replaced by parent ~[NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0034356)~ GO:0034355 NAD biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway



Thanks, 

Pascale
title: Review annotations to GO:0034356 NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway'

author: pgaudet
source_title: Obsoletion notice: GO:0034627 de novo' NAD biosynthetic process  and -  GO:0034356 NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway

author: deustp01
body:
> Note that this term will be replaced by parent [NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0034356)

This looks like an error, as this is the term to be replaced. Is the parent  GO:0034355 NAD biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway meant here? (Anyway that works fine to patch the Reactome pathway and its 11 associated gene products.) Reactome fixed accordingly.

author: rozaru
body:
The idea was to merge GO:0034356 NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway with the new term [NAD biosynthetic process via the salvage pathway](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0034355).
I think that was what Pascale meant.

author: deustp01
body: Reactome instances were fixed earlier (fixes will become public in our March 2025 release).
